[LDEB.1.4] Design invariant, sibling to [LTES]'s: **every
decision the engine makes about a rule must be inspectable by
the rule author.** Pattern matches, joins, test-CE results,
activation priority, firing order, justification chains,
retraction causes, timer activations, cross-tier emissions —
all visible. An opaque engine decision is a debugging-surface
bug.
